content.value: Define the first and second law of thermodynamics. Derive an expression for the combined statement of first and second law. [Use Table 1].

content.value_html: V = V(T, P) S = S(T, P) U = U(T, P)dV = VαdT − Vβ dP Cp dS = dT − VαdP T dU = (Cp − PVα)dT + V(pβ − Tα)dP dH = CpdT + V(1 − Tα)dP
